command: p=$(cat /tmp/voice-gui-display/voice.pid); kill "$p"; n=0; while kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 15 || break; done; ! kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; xqaudio-capture /tmp/c70-idle.wav 2

cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; PIKAFISH_MAC_BACKEND=mmio-shadow PIKAFISH_STAGEB_ACCEL=verify XQ_GUI_INPUT=/run/voice-display.in ./xiangqi-gui-display-v3 </dev/null >gui-gather-verify.log 2>&1 & echo $! >gui-v3.pid; n=0; until grep -q "XQ LINUX PIKAFISH READY" gui-gather-verify.log; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 80 || break; done; tail -8 gui-gather-verify.log; grep -q "XQ LINUX PIKAFISH READY" gui-gather-verify.log
